failure_summary.description: Agents omitted the latest request or accepted preference, or continued work on an unrelated earlier domain.
Agents used nonexistent or invalid cache results, failed to save tool outputs, or treated retrieval as completing the request.
Agents did not consistently map the user's intended location granularity, rating meaning, or proximity target to the matching tool arguments.

patch.reasoning: The skill already states the individual cache and result-handling rules, but the trajectories show agents failing to apply them to the complete latest-turn delta. A final coverage audit makes the call plan explicitly accountable to each new request and helps catch stale-domain calls, omitted preferences, invalid cache refinements, and mismatched tool arguments before execution.

edits.content: - Before emitting code, audit the planned calls against the latest turn and full conversation: for each new request or accepted preference, identify its intended item, domain, relation, and schema-supported argument, then verify that a planned call includes it. Do not reprocess unchanged domains. Use only a listed, compatible cache result for refinement; if none exists and mandatory inputs are available, search instead of filtering. After the audit, use `print("No planning needed")` only if no requested action or constraint remains unsatisfied by valid cached results.
